summary: Relay Therapeutics filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, announcing initial clinical data from the Phase 2 ReInspire trial of zovegalisib in vascular anomalies. The filing contains no special-situation event—it is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results. No transaction, activist, strategic review, or other special situation is involved. The press release and slide presentation were furnished under Item 7.01, not deemed filed. This is a standard biotech pipeline update, not requiring categorization as a special situation.
